dialogue.text: Today a new moon is in the sky a 23 inch metal sphere placed in orbit by a Russian rocket. Here an artist's conception of how the feet was accomplished. A three-stage rocket. Number one, the booster in the class of an intercontinental missile.
dialogue.zh: 今天天空中有一個新月亮，一個23英寸的金屬球體由俄羅斯火箭送入軌道。這裡是一位藝術家對這項壯舉如何完成的想像圖。這是一枚三段式火箭。第一段是洲際導彈級的助推器。
dialogue.ja: 今日は新しい月が空にあります。23インチの金属球がロシアのロケットによって軌道に乗せられました。ここに、その偉業がどのように達成されたかを示すアーティストの想像図があります。三段式ロケットの第一段は、大陸間ミサイル級のブースターです。
dialogue.local: Today a new moon is in the sky a 23 inch metal sphere placed in orbit by a Russian rocket. Here an artist's conception of how the feet was accomplished. A three-stage rocket. Number one, the booster in the class of an intercontinental missile.
dialogue.en: Today a new moon is in the sky a 23 inch metal sphere placed in orbit by a Russian rocket. Here an artist's conception of how the feet was accomplished. A three-stage rocket. Number one, the booster in the class of an intercontinental missile.

dialogue.text: It's weight estimated at 50 tons. The smaller second stage took over at 5000 miles an hour and carried on to the highest point reached.
dialogue.zh: 它的重量估計為50噸。較小的第二段在時速5000英里時接手，並繼續飛向達到的最高點。
dialogue.ja: その重さは約50トンと推定されています。より小さな第二段は時速5000マイルで引き継ぎ、到達した最高点まで運びました。
dialogue.local: It's weight estimated at 50 tons. The smaller second stage took over at 5000 miles an hour and carried on to the highest point reached.
dialogue.en: It's weight estimated at 50 tons. The smaller second stage took over at 5000 miles an hour and carried on to the highest point reached.

dialogue.text: 500 miles up the artificial moon is boosted to a speed counterbalancing the pull of gravity and released.
dialogue.zh: 在500英里高空，這個人造月球被加速到一個抵消重力拉力的速度，然後釋放。
dialogue.ja: 500マイル上空で、その人工の月は重力の引力と釣り合う速度まで加速され、放たれました。
dialogue.local: 500 miles up the artificial moon is boosted to a speed counterbalancing the pull of gravity and released.
dialogue.en: 500 miles up the artificial moon is boosted to a speed counterbalancing the pull of gravity and released.

dialogue.text: You are hearing the actual signals transmitted by the earth circling satellite. One of the great scientific feats of the age.
dialogue.zh: 你現在聽到的是地球繞行衛星傳送的實際信號。這是這個時代偉大的科學壯舉之一。
dialogue.ja: あなたは地球を周回する衛星から送信される実際の信号を聞いています。これは時代の偉大な科学的偉業の一つです。
dialogue.local: You are hearing the actual signals transmitted by the earth circling satellite. One of the great scientific feats of the age.
dialogue.en: You are hearing the actual signals transmitted by the earth circling satellite. One of the great scientific feats of the age.
